patch.title: New client
patch.description: Home, Modes, Collection, Loot, Store, Digi-Farm and Codex in one launcher, with a friends list, a party screen and a match loading screen.

patch.title: Sets
patch.description: Faction Wars, Fates, Galaxies, Gizmos & Gadgets, Reckoning, Dragonlands, Into the Arcane, K.O. Coliseum, Undermons, Auto Chess and Undermons Knockout. Chaos plays a random set every game. Browse every set in the Codex.

patch.title: Digi-Farm
patch.description: Raise your Little Legends on a themed island. Four training mini-games raise their stats.

patch.title: Digivolution
patch.description: Little Legends level up, then digivolve along their own trees up to Ultimate.

patch.title: Digi-Eggs
patch.description: Rare, epic and legendary Little Legends only hatch from eggs. Open them from Loot.

patch.title: Boards and dances
patch.description: 27 arena boards, some react to the fight. 11 dances for kill screens and previews.

patch.title: Item cards
patch.description: Drag an item over a Digimon to see what it will make before you drop it.

events.title: Daily rotation
events.countdown: Missions, the daily bonus and the featured Store row reset in {countdown}.
events.storeDescription: Four items at 25% off, new every day. Your first game today pays {bits} extra Bits.
events.farmDescription: Hunger, energy and happiness run on real time, also while the game is closed. Check on your partners.
